name: indate-tools
description: Tools for working with Claude Code: a runtime debugging harness, and deterministic recall of past sessions.

plugins.name: devharness
plugins.description: Run and debug a live app from inside Claude Code: breakpoints and variable inspection in Chrome and Node.js, managed dev servers, and replayable call history so setup is never re-driven by hand.

plugins.name: chsum
plugins.description: Recover past Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions as verbatim context: list a project's sessions, digest one into prompts, files changed, commands run and where it left off, or drill into a subagent's own work. Nothing is model-generated.
